about_the_game:
Type & Magic is a puzzle platformer where you must create the platforms yourself. 

You are a sorcerer’s apprentice, sent to investigate the ruins of a mysterious castle. Type the words to create a path to walk on. Traverse collapsing halls filled with traps and forgotten secrets.

Can you hear the castle whispering to you?

But you weren’t just sent here to observe. Your master awaits your report.

What you tell him is up to you.

Features

  • Type to build: Create your path one letter at a time with a unique word-based platforming mechanic.

  • Puzzle platforming with a twist: Think before you type. Navigate levels that test not just your typing skills, but your puzzle-solving and timing.

  • Auto-walk mechanics: Your character never stops moving. Use walls, jumps, and well-timed typing to guide them through the level.

  • Choose your difficulty: If you are feeling like an extra challenge, some levels contain additional puzzles that take you to hidden artifacts. If you ever get stuck, just use a hint.

  • Uncover a mystery: Find scraps of lore and listen to the castle’s whispers to discover its dark history.

  • Multiple endings: What you report to your master and how you engage with the world shapes the outcome of the story.

reviews:
“It’s a very clever concept that not only tests your typing skills but your timing and problem solving skills too. The pixel art style looks excellent and there’s a surprisingly deep lore to the world and the castle you’re exploring. Highly recommended.”
Free Game Planet
short_description: Type words to shape your path, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of a dead wizard’s castle. Find artifacts to uncover the castle’s dark mysteries. Report everything you saw to your master. Or… don’t.
